metadata.title: Micron Stock Rebounds as Chip Slump Suddenly Reverses<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron Stock Rebounds as Chip Slump Suddenly Reverses
Micron stock was rising early Thursday, reversing premarket losses as chip-sector selling came to an abrupt end and normal service resumed.
